summary: Website with admin-only authorized access to manage clues, publicly viewable pages, and user progression via changing the URL.

existing_features.title: Update the frontend routing so that all public clue/progress pages are accessible under a base path that includes the word "echofields" (for example: "/echofields/..."), without breaking the existing URL-based progression behavior. Ensure any admin management area routes also include "echofields" in their path (for example: "/echofields/admin").

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin/authenticated access for managing site content (authorized access for owner/admin)
Publicly viewable clue/progress pages accessible to anyone without login
Progression mechanism where users advance by changing/visiting specific URLs (URL-based navigation/progression)
Admin can add/delete (manage) clues whenever (clue CRUD management)
Implement admin-only authorized access using Internet Identity so that only the admin can manage (create/delete) clues, while the rest of the site remains publicly viewable without login.
Create a backend data model and persistence for clues that supports listing clues and reading a clue by a URL-safe identifier, and supports admin-only create and delete operations at any time.
Implement public clue/progress pages where users progress by visiting/changing the URL (e.g., visiting a specific clue URL loads the corresponding clue content).
Add an admin management area to add and delete clues, designed to be easy to use (simple form + list with delete controls).

Apply a cohesive visual theme across the site (colors, typography, spacing, and layout) suitable for a clue/progress website, avoiding a blue/purple default look, and keep styling consistent across public pages and the admin area.
Include the words 'echofields' in the website URL (e.g., as part of the domain or base path for clue/progress URLs)

architectural_notes: Decide how to incorporate 'echofields' into the public URL structure (domain/subdomain vs base path prefix) so all clue/progress routes include it.
projectName: Public clue-by-URL site with admin-only clue management
